title: DAE Target: 5 Indigenous Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) Operational by 2033 under SHANTI Act
summary: BARC develops BSMR-200, SMR-55, and HTGCR models with ₹20,000 crore total SMR outlay.

blocks.content: BARC develops BSMR-200, SMR-55, and HTGCR models with ₹20,000 crore total SMR outlay.

items: 3 SMR Models: BSMR-200 (220 MWe, Tarapur), SMR-55 (55 MWe, Tarapur), and HTGCR (5 MWth gas-cooled, Visakhapatnam).
Capacity Target: Nuclear capacity expanding from 8.78 GW to 22 GW (2031-32) and 100 GW by 2047 under SHANTI Act 2025.
